parsed_object.reason: The phase003 singleton demonstrated that mixed-arity phase changes physically close, meet timing (D=2.081ns), and reduce stress energy despite a slight net J increase from uniform/low profiles. The proposed global assignment 'mixed_global_area_then_xnor2_v1' operates directly on verified baseline c6c10558 with a distinct multi-gate transformation (9 master flips across both arity-2 and arity-3 cells, eliminating XOR3 instances for XNOR3 shrinks, -2.5024 um2 cell area proxy) that passed pure structural and parity checks. Running full proof and 3-profile route measurement will definitively test whether co-optimizing arity-3 shrinks and arity-2 phase inversions yields a Pareto improvement in J over the baseline or confirms the profile-dependent energy trade-off observed in phase003.
parsed_object.expected_discriminator: Comparison of physical routed delay against <=2.4ns ceiling, net cell and layout area, and 3-workload (stress, uniform, low) energy breakdown against c6c10558 to evaluate whether simultaneous arity-3 to XNOR3 conversion and balanced arity-2 inversion lowers composite J.
